MacroName LowDoseWizard

##################DO NOT EDIT ANYTHING IN THIS SCRIPT!#############
# Name: LowDoseWizard
# Author: Simon Fromm
# Version: 1.0
# SerialEM version: 4.2.X or higher
# Last update: 22.04.2026
# Support: simon.fromm@embl.de
###################################################################

Echo
Echo =================================================
Echo Starting LowDoseWizard.
Echo =================================================

#################################################
# Cleanup any carry-over variables for a fresh start
#################################################
SetColumnOrGunValve 0

ClearPersistentVars
SuppressReports

ReportNumOpenFiles
Loop $repVal1
   CloseFile
EndLoop

IsTextFileOpen PAR
If $repVal1 == 1
   CloseTextFile PAR
Endif

#################################################
# Load system config file
#################################################

ReportSystemPath
ReadStringsFromFile system $repVal1\wizard_system_config.txt
CallStringArray system

#################################################
# Define the NavItem # for empty and sample area
#################################################
ReportOtherItem -1
total = $repVal1
Loop $total index
   ReportOtherItem $index
   CompareStrings navLabel empty
   If $repVal1 == 0
      empty = $index
      Break
   Endif
EndLoop

Loop $total index
   ReportOtherItem $index
   CompareStrings navLabel sample
   If $repVal1 == 0
      sample = $index
      Break
   Endif
EndLoop

# Check if both empty and sample have been found
IsVariableDefined empty
If $repVal1 == 0
   OKBox No empty area is defined. Please add a point at an empty area on your grid map (atlas) and change its label in the Navigtor window to 'empty'. Then restart theLowDoseWizard.
   Exit No empty area is defined. Please add a point at an empty area on your grid map (atlas) and change its label in the Navigator window to 'empty'. Then restart the LowDoseWizard.
Endif

IsVariableDefined sample
If $repVal1 == 0
   OKBox No sample area is defined. Please add a point at a sacrificial sample area on your grid map (atlas) and change its label in the Navigator window to 'sample'. Then restart theLowDoseWizard.
   Exit No sample area is defined. Please add a point at a sacrificial sample area on your grid map (atlas) and change its label in the Navigator window to 'sample'. Then restart the LowDoseWizard.
Endif

MakeVarPersistent empty
MakeVarPersistent sample

#################################################
# Call the low dose OPTICS setup routine
#################################################
####################TIMING#######################
ReportTickTime
start = $repVal1
####################TIMING#######################

ParseQuotedStrings 1
header = { 'Do you want to setup Low Dose Mode OPTICS (areas)? Can be skipped if already done and the Wizard will continue with other routines.' }
prompt1 = { '1: YES' }
prompt2 = { '2: NO, but continue with the Wizard.' }
prompt3 = { '3: Get me out of the Wizard.' }
buttons = { '1: Yes' '2: No' '3: Abort Wizard' }
ThreeChoiceBox header prompt1 prompt2 prompt3 buttons
If $repVal1 == 1
   FindScriptByName wizard_optics
   CallScript -1
ElseIf $repVal1 == 2
   Echo Low dose areas (optics) have not been modified.
ElseIf $repVal1 == 3
   SetColumnOrGunValve 0
   OKBox LowDoseWizard aborted as per user request. Column Valves are closed.
   Exit LowDoseWizard aborted as per user request. Column Valves are closed.
Endif
ParseQuotedStrings 0

####################TIMING#######################
ElapsedTickTime $start
TIME = $repVal1
Echo Optics took $TIME sec
####################TIMING#######################
#################################################
# Call the CAMERA setup routine
#################################################
####################TIMING#######################
ReportTickTime
start = $repVal1
####################TIMING#######################

ParseQuotedStrings 1
header = { 'Do you want to run the CAMERA setup routine to calibrate flux and set optimal exposure times?' }
prompt1 = { '1: YES' }
prompt2 = { '2: NO, but continue with the Wizard.' }
prompt3 = { '3: Get me out of the Wizard.' }
buttons = { '1: Yes' '2: No' '3: Abort Wizard' }
ThreeChoiceBox header prompt1 prompt2 prompt3 buttons
If $repVal1 == 1
   FindScriptByName wizard_camera
   CallScript -1
ElseIf $repVal1 == 2
   Echo Camera settings have not been touched!
ElseIf $repVal1 == 3
   SetColumnOrGunValve 0
   OKBox LowDoseWizard aborted as per user request. Column Valves are closed.
   Exit LowDoseWizard aborted as per user request. Column Valves are closed.
Endif
ParseQuotedStrings 0

####################TIMING#######################
ElapsedTickTime $start
TIME = $repVal1
Echo Camera took $TIME sec
####################TIMING#######################
#################################################
# Call the IMAGE SHIFT offset calibration routine
#################################################
####################TIMING#######################
ReportTickTime
start = $repVal1
####################TIMING#######################

ParseQuotedStrings 1
header = { 'Do you want to calibrate the IMAGE SHIFT offsets between Record, View and Search?' }
prompt1 = { '1: YES' }
prompt2 = { '2: NO, but continue with the Wizard.' }
prompt3 = { '3: Get me out of the Wizard.' }
buttons = { '1: Yes' '2: No' '3: Abort Wizard' }
ThreeChoiceBox header prompt1 prompt2 prompt3 buttons
If $repVal1 == 1
   FindScriptByName wizard_imageshift
   CallScript -1
ElseIf $repVal1 == 2
   Echo Image Shift offsets calibration has been skipped.
ElseIf $repVal1 == 3
   SetColumnOrGunValve 0
   OKBox LowDoseWizard aborted as per user request. Column Valves are closed.
   Exit LowDoseWizard aborted as per user request. Column Valves are closed.
Endif
ParseQuotedStrings 0

####################TIMING#######################
ElapsedTickTime $start
TIME = $repVal1
Echo Imageshift took $TIME sec
####################TIMING#######################
#################################################
# Call the TUNE scope routine
#################################################
####################TIMING#######################
ReportTickTime
start = $repVal1
####################TIMING#######################

ParseQuotedStrings 1
header = { 'Do you want to TUNE astigmatism and coma? NOTE: This will only work if your support foil or sample gives sufficient Thon rings!' }
prompt1 = { '1: YES' }
prompt2 = { '2: NO, but continue with the Wizard.' }
prompt3 = { '3: Get me out of the Wizard.' }
buttons = { '1: Yes' '2: No' '3: Abort Wizard' }
ThreeChoiceBox header prompt1 prompt2 prompt3 buttons
If $repVal1 == 1
   FindScriptByName wizard_tune
   CallScript -1
ElseIf $repVal1 == 2
   YesNoBox Do you want to insert and center an objective aperture?
   If $repVal1 == 1
      FindScriptByName wizard_objap
      CallScript -1
   ElseIf $repVal1 == 2
      Echo No objective aperture inserted.
   Endif
ElseIf $repVal1 == 3
   SetColumnOrGunValve 0
   OKBox LowDoseWizard aborted as per user request. Column Valves are closed.
   Exit LowDoseWizard aborted as per user request. Column Valves are closed.
Endif
ParseQuotedStrings 0

####################TIMING#######################
ElapsedTickTime $start
TIME = $repVal1
Echo Tuning took $TIME sec
####################TIMING#######################
#################################################
# Wrap things up
#################################################
SetColumnOrGunValve 0

#################################################
# Close parameter text file if open
#################################################

IsTextFileOpen PAR
If $repVal1 == 1
   CloseTextFile PAR
   Echo
   Echo A LowDoseWizard parameter file (ldw_parameters.txt) has been saved to the current SerialEM working directory and can be used to reapply the same parameters in future sessions.
Endif

#################################################
# Generate SUMMARY txt file
#################################################
FindScriptByName wizard_summary
CallScript -1

OKBox Completed all requested LowDoseWizard routines. NOTE: There are still some things that need to be done. See the LOG for details.
Echo
Echo =================================================
Echo Completed all requested LowDoseWizard routines.
Echo Things that still need to be done:
Echo ***'Shift To Marker' to correct for the offset between grid map (atlas) and Search (i.e. the Low Dose areas).
Echo ***Define your Focus position.
Echo ***Setup Frame saving in Record.
Echo ***Tune the Energy Filter, if applicable.
Echo ***It is recommended to (again) perform astigmatism and coma-free alignement (microscope tuning) just before starting data acquisition.
Echo ***Calibrate Coma vs. Image shift if necessary.
Echo NOTE: Column Valves are closed.
Echo =================================================
Echo
Exit
